description: This file defines utility functions for error checking related to battery cell cycling procedures, including parameter validation for calendar aging, cycle aging, and charge/discharge processes. It includes inline functions that perform parameter checks and throw exceptions on invalid inputs.

methods.name: checkInputParam_CalAge
methods.description: Checks validity of parameters for calendar aging, including voltage, temperature, and mode constraints.

methods.name: checkInputParam_CC_V_CV_I
methods.description: Validates voltage and current parameters for charge/discharge cycles.

methods.name: checkInputParam_CycAge
methods.description: Checks parameters for cycle aging, including voltage, temperature, and cycle counts.
